title: Prove JavaParser startup for supplied and cleared separators
description: Use the original parent and fix JARs on Temurin 21.0.13. Compare the pilot to the new native checker on every non-null separator through three UTF-16 units. Check both real initializer failures after a clear, and both frozen trees with an arbitrary caller-supplied separator through two units. No application class is preinitialized. Replay the native parent witness on a fresh unmodified JVM.

steps.name: Check explicit startup on the original parent
Check explicit startup on the landed fix
